book.name: Ioane
book.title: Ioane Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Ioaneꞌa Mirihiro

content: Iesu ebu Samaria Roḡaeḡa
Iesuꞌa Ioane vitine ani tahiꞌatahiꞌa ufeta ḡehaḡa zamazadu babatisoziꞌeteꞌe hariḡa Farisea azaḡaniꞌa igiro.
Aꞌe Iesuꞌa mene babatisoziro, rehano ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa babatisoziro.
Aniꞌe Farisea azaḡaniꞌa ani moneo ḡoereꞌeteꞌe ederirotene, Iudea habaꞌa modadu bare Galilea habaꞌa onamiro.
Galilea habaꞌa onameꞌeteꞌe ibiḡano aniꞌe Samaria habaꞌa vitine onamiro.
ꞌOugadu Samaria habaꞌano ne boro ꞌahoga, niḡa Sukao feuriro. Eꞌe neḡaꞌe Iakoboꞌa ubuga Iosefa haroteꞌe habaꞌa uhiḡano,
ebu Iakobo idu vuḡa zuni eꞌea. Iesuꞌa ibi faḡa aradu fuḡone runiro ꞌahine, idu vuḡa genaḡano ehore radiro. Aꞌe madai kirikiri.
Samaria roḡaeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa vu abi ariro. Iesuꞌa ani horonadu niro, “Vu gagifine nu iniꞌumahe?”
Eꞌe madaḡano Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe ogomu hoitoga veize ne onamadu ani teite mene radiro.
Ebu Samaria roḡaeḡaniꞌa niro, “Ḡaꞌe Iuda vazeḡa, u eꞌe Samaria roḡaeḡa. Nougadu ḡa eḡe mazao vu umideꞌohe?” Iuda azaḡaꞌe Samaria azaḡa teite mene tiburuꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, ani ꞌouge rae reiro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Ḡa Badiꞌaꞌa nagi ḡahunoneḡa ḡanihi rae ederifone zu ḡae mazao vu umiꞌeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe iniu rae ederifone, ḡa umihadu eḡeꞌa ḡabone vuḡa ḡanifo.”
Roḡae eꞌeꞌa niro, “Vaze boro, ḡae mazao vu abeꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡaꞌe oꞌoꞌa zu idu vuḡa ꞌahiꞌe vo hutuna. Ḡabone vuḡaꞌe nouma meꞌuma?
Emeḡe vouḡa Iakoboꞌa idu vuḡa ꞌahi rifiro. Ani idu ꞌahi vuḡanonoꞌo vu gagiro, ebu ani ubuga duḡuru zu aneꞌa ḡubuziroteꞌe ḡauḡa zuni vu ꞌahi gagiro. Ḡaꞌe ani ufeta vitine ḡihiꞌaḡahe?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Iniuꞌa vu ꞌadi gageꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe iriganiꞌa bare moꞌoniꞌuma.
Rehano iniu eḡeꞌa hauꞌeteꞌe vuḡa gageꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe iriga mene bare moꞌoniꞌuma. Eḡeꞌa hauꞌeteꞌe vuḡaꞌe ane zamao sore iteꞌeteꞌe iduḡa vuḡa teigiꞌuma ebu ḡabone tuḡutuḡu haꞌuma.”
Roḡae eꞌeꞌa niro, “Vaze boro, eꞌe vuḡaꞌe eḡe enoꞌi. ꞌOugine, irinehe mene bare moꞌohiꞌuma zu vu aboḡa veize e ꞌahi mene bare ariꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Ḡa onamadu iꞌu hune aroꞌi.”
Roḡae eꞌeꞌa naenaeniro, “E ihe oꞌoꞌa.” Iesuꞌa niro, “Ḡaꞌa iꞌu oꞌoꞌa raꞌetaꞌaꞌe hube.
Ḡaꞌe ibite iꞌu fuꞌo meiro, ebu izidi ḡae teite radiuꞌeteꞌe ohozeḡa zuni ḡae mene iꞌu. Ḡaꞌa rataꞌaꞌe hube.”
Ebu roḡae eꞌeꞌa niro, “Vaze boro, e ḡaꞌe peroveta vazeḡa rae edereha.
Vouḡafe, Samaria azaḡaniꞌa Gerizimi maḡa ꞌada kuraro. Rehano za, Iuda azaḡaꞌe, 'Kuru habaꞌaꞌe Ierusalema daꞌo,' rae raꞌohe.”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Roḡae, eḡe ḡoere ꞌahi mae ḡihinoꞌi. Mada ꞌahoganiꞌa arine, za Mama mazao kurauꞌeteꞌe habaꞌaꞌe mene maḡa ꞌada ga mene Ierusalemao reꞌuma.
Za, Samaria azaḡaꞌe iniu mazao kurauꞌetaꞌaꞌe aḡuꞌa. U eme, Iuda azaḡaꞌe iniu mazao kurauꞌetaꞌaꞌe edeḡa, mazaḡa Badiꞌaꞌa vaze ḡaboziteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe Iuda azaḡa mazaonoꞌo tuḡuniro.

Rehano hube hune kurauꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa Badiꞌa Vine inaraḡa hina zu ḡoere huga hina Mama mazao kuratiteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa ariꞌuma, ebu izidiꞌe eꞌe madaḡa raꞌohe. Mamaꞌa ani mazao ꞌouge kurauꞌeteꞌe azaḡa vaḡeꞌohe.
Badiꞌaꞌe vine, eꞌanoꞌo iniuꞌa ani mazao kurauꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Badiꞌa Vine inaraḡa hina zu ḡoere huga hina kuraꞌuma.”
Roḡae eꞌeꞌa niro, “Eḡe edeḡa, Mesia, Keriso rae huneꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ariꞌuma. Aniꞌa arine, ḡau niduꞌa ihofiꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Izidi ḡaꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe Keriso, eḡe.”
Iesu Tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa Bariro

Iesuꞌa ꞌouge ḡoerirotene, ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa feuri ariro. Ebu ze zaguzagaro, mazaḡa aniꞌe roḡae ꞌahoga teite ḡoere radiro. Rehano vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa Iesu mazao ninaꞌa, “Ḡa nougihi raꞌohe?” ga “Ḡa nougadu ani teite ḡoereꞌohe?” rae mene ḡadiniro.
Ebu roḡae eꞌeꞌa vu ḡoḡoreḡa modadu ne onamiro, ebu ne azaḡa ziro,
“Aradu vaze ꞌadi ḡianoꞌi! Ani eḡeꞌa haḡairoteꞌe haḡaiḡa niduꞌa eheha. Aniꞌe Keriso gaogi!”
Ebu ze neze modadu Iesu vaḡe onamiro.
Hiriveꞌeteꞌe Azaḡa
Eꞌe zamaḡano Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa Iesu uminiro, “Rabi, ḡa ogomu nu anoꞌi.”
Rehano aniꞌa ziro, “Ogomuꞌe eḡe mazao eꞌe, rehano zaꞌe ogomu eꞌe moneoꞌe aḡuꞌa.”
Ebu ze zeḡeꞌa bare ḡadimutitiro, “Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa ogomu hanahe?”
Iesuꞌa ziro, “Eḡe ogomuꞌe eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe vazeḡa ura haḡaeꞌeteꞌe zu ane gau haḡae huneꞌeteꞌe raꞌohe.
Zaꞌe, 'Bato ḡazaḡa enogano hiriviteꞌe madaḡa meꞌuma,' rae raꞌohe. Rehano eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, ubumaze raꞌanadu meba faine ḡianoꞌi. Meba ogomuḡaniꞌa hudanadu hiriveꞌeteꞌe madaḡa ꞌai maha.
Hiriveꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe gauḡa naeḡa hideꞌohe, ebu ane hirivadu ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hideꞌeteꞌe huga nuꞌoneꞌohe. ꞌOugine, ḡorauꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa zu hiriveꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa, anianine matuꞌe tiburaꞌuma.
Ḡoere ꞌahiꞌe hube, 'Vaze ꞌahogaꞌe ḡorauꞌohe ebu ꞌahogaꞌe hiriveꞌohe.'
Zaeꞌa mene ḡoraroteꞌe ogomuḡa hirivoga veize e za tuḡuziro. Vaze ꞌahogaꞌahogaꞌe gau boro haḡairo, u zaꞌe zeḡe gauonoꞌo huga maꞌohe.”
Samaria Azaḡaniꞌa Iesu mazao Firo
Ne beꞌanoꞌo Samaria azaḡa ḡehaḡaniꞌa Iesu mazao firo, mazaḡa roḡae eꞌeꞌa ꞌahige rae fureniro, “Ani eꞌa haḡairoteꞌe haḡaiḡa niduꞌa eheha.”
Ze ani vaḡe aradu uminiro, “Emeḡe teite mada nu radoꞌi.” ꞌOugadu aniꞌe zeḡe teite mada aheu eꞌea radiro.
Ebu Iesu ḡoere uꞌano, vaze ufeta ḡehaḡaniꞌa ani mazao firo.

Ebu zeḡeꞌa roḡae eꞌe niro, “Emeꞌe mene ḡae ḡoere uꞌano, rehano eme emeḡeꞌa bare ani ḡoere egateꞌe uꞌano ani mazao fieꞌohe. Mazaḡa eme edereha, vaze ꞌadiꞌe hube hune raha ꞌadi azaḡa niduꞌa ḡabozeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa.”
Kini Gau Vazeḡa Ubuga Fainiro
Mada aheu enogano Iesuꞌe eꞌea iḡunadu Galilea habaꞌa onamiro.
Mazaḡa ani aneꞌa bare ꞌahige rae reiro, “Peroveta vazeḡaꞌe ane haba azaḡaniꞌa mene gubaneꞌohe.”
Ani Galilea habaꞌano feurirotene, Galilea azaḡaniꞌa ani mae zouniro, mazaḡa ze Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa madaḡano Ierusalemao radiuꞌenaꞌa, Iesuꞌa Mui eꞌe zamaḡano haḡairoteꞌe haḡaiḡa niduꞌa horoniro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa Galilea habaꞌano Kana neḡa bare onamiro. Aꞌe vu ḡihune vaini vuḡano haḡairoteꞌe neḡa. Eꞌea kini gau vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa radiunu, ebu ani ubugaꞌe ugiꞌa madu Kaperanauma zamaḡano radiunu.
Aniꞌe Iesuꞌa Iudea habaꞌanonoꞌo Galilea habaꞌano feuri ariroteꞌe igirotene, ani vaḡe onamadu uminiro, “Ubudeheꞌe ugiꞌa madu nariga rudauꞌohe. Ḡa eḡe teite Kaperanauma ovoadu ani fainoꞌi.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa niro, “Zaꞌe haḡai nu badeḡa zu zaguzagatiteꞌe haḡaiḡa mene horonine, eḡe mazao mene fiꞌuma.”
Kini gau vazeḡaniꞌa niro, “Vaze boro, ubudehe ꞌizema rudanogano, aro ovoihi.”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Onamoꞌi. Ubugoꞌe ḡabodiꞌuma.” ꞌOuge reirotene, ani Iesu ḡoere mae ḡihiniro ebu ani ne ovoiro.
Ani ibio ovoeꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano, ane tuḡure azaḡaniꞌa ani hidadu ihoniro, “Ubugoꞌe ḡabodeha!”
Ebu aniꞌa ḡadiziro, “Ubudeheꞌe naniꞌa manoreha?” Zeḡeꞌa niro, “Ohoḡore ḡorava mone mada tiba zamaḡano gigiꞌaniꞌa hauḡeha.”
ꞌOugadu mogaꞌe ederiro, eꞌe madaḡaꞌe Iesuꞌa, “Ubugoꞌe ḡabodiꞌuma,” rae reiroteꞌe madaḡa. Eꞌanoꞌo ani zu ane neo tiburu radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe Iesu mazao firo.
Aꞌe Iesuꞌa Iudea habaꞌanonoꞌo Galilea habaꞌa ariroteꞌe enogano haḡairoteꞌe haḡai nu badeḡa aheuḡa.
